items.title: 1967 VIETNAM WAR DAILIES  9TH INFANTRY DIVISION   MEKONG DELTA PATROL OPERATIONS 83414
items.description: This color silent film footage was shot during the Vietnam War and shows day to day operations of members of the 9th Infantry Division ("Old Reliables"). All the material was filmed circa Spring, 1967 in and around the Mekong Delta. The footage gives a sense of the monotony of life for many soldiers
